description: This Java class implements the <else-if> element for the mini-language within the OFBiz framework, providing conditional logic capabilities in the mini-language.

classes.name: ElseIf
classes.description: Represents an else-if element in the mini-language, handling condition evaluation and associated sub-operations.

methods.name: ElseIf
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an ElseIf instance by parsing an XML element, validating child elements, and setting up the condition and sub-operations.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates the condition associated with this else-if element within a given method context.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gathers artifact information from all sub-operations contained within this else-if element.

methods.name: getThenSubOps
methods.description: Returns the list of sub-operations to execute if the condition is true.

methods.name: runSubOps
methods.description: Executes the sub-operations associated with this else-if element within the provided method context.
